## bijection_verdict

## dependency_form
- The prerequisite sentence stands once, verbatim, blockquoted, in the card (blocked side); not restated in action form; no performer or tool beside it.
- No other problem's tool in the card; no route, checklist or chain; the depended-on Service Note does not disclose that the loan-event credit waits on it.
- Titles general (loan-event schedule and the lender's cancellation; commercial placement schedule service note). No task mirror.
- Depended-on doc reachable with the sentence/record words ("certificate issued", "first notice", "commercial placement").
- Computation doc silent about variation; factor docs neither name the computation doc nor another factor nor assign customers to tiers.
- Verdict: **PASS** (no KB-EXPLICIT RED).
